summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long RGTI Daily ETF (RGTU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Rigetti Computing Inc. stock. RGTU was launched on Jun 23, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.

data.title: Tradr Launches Leveraged ETFs on Quantum Computing Inc. (QUBT) and Rigetti Computing (RGTI)
